notes: This scenario is easy: a frequency-only Isolation Forest already reaches AUC 0.988, so a high LSTM score here is not strong evidence on its own.
Thresholds learned from validation recordings gave about 7.5% false alarms at the 99th percentile, so validation and test normals differ somewhat.
The tuned threshold uses labelled attack recordings from the tuning half, so it is not a normal-data-only setting.
